title: Art. 9.15 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, B. Advance Passenger Information (API), 9.15
content: Contracting States requiring that passenger data be transmitted electronically through an API system shall not also require a passenger manifest in paper form.
text: Contracting States requiring that passenger data be transmitted electronically through an API system shall not also require a passenger manifest in paper form.
